# Code Anchors: Template Seeding

- `libs/portable-tools/src/seed-templates.ts` — the seed itself: the named set, the payload and checkout master locations, the project destination, and the read-whole-then-write pass that keeps and reports an existing file.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/seed-templates.spec.ts` — coverage for whole-set validation before any write, never-clobber, the seeded/kept split, and byte-identical first seed.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the repo-bound verb: its registry entry and usage text, the target and masters options, the default master location inside the release, and the seeded/kept report.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/release-payload.ts` — adds the template masters as the third part of the payload, so a seed reads what the adopter installed.
- `libs/portable-tools/payload-manifest.json` — the committed record that the three masters ship.
- `common/templates/close-record-template.md` — the close-record master.
- `common/templates/decision-record-template.md` — the decision-record master.
- `common/templates/standard.template.md` — the standards master the setup stage reads.
- `components/commands/nxs.setup.md` — runs the seed before the phase that reads the standards template, and corrects its own statement that it does not seed them.
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — stops on an absent close-record template, reporting the path and naming the seed as the remedy.
